# ANGRAMM®

> ANGRAMM is a creative agency and audiovisual production company. Driven by major collaborations with high-profile partners, we bring our creative and technical expertise to any industry, both in France and internationally.

ANGRAMM is a creative agency and audiovisual production company. Driven by major collaborations with high-profile partners, we bring our creative and technical expertise to any industry, both in France and internationally. An engram is the trace a memory leaves in the brain. That's where ANGRAMM comes from: images that stay with people, quietly, long after the screen goes dark.

Based in Marseille, France. Contact: contact@angramm.com

## Films

- [OLYMPIQUE DE MARSEILLE · EXP. VOLCANO](https://angramm.com/work/om/) (2026): A film for Olympique de Marseille unveiling the 2026/27 kit. Live action and CGI meet in a cinematic expedition, from the stands to the heart of a blue-lit volcano.
- [LES MARSEILLAISES · Prise du Vel](https://angramm.com/work/om-prise-du-vel/) (2026): Les Marseillaises take over the Vélodrome: a campaign for the Olympique de Marseille women's team, from neighbourhood pitches and hairdressers to a packed stadium, for their match against Montpellier at the Orange Vélodrome.
- [CMA CGM x OM · Driven by passion](https://angramm.com/work/cma-cgm-om/) (2025): Driven by passion: CMA CGM and Olympique de Marseille, from the containers of the port of Marseille to the pitch.
- [LACOSTE FW26 x Family 3.0 · AFTER RAIN](https://angramm.com/work/lacoste/) (2026): An elevator, a single floor and a vinyl session: Lacoste's FW26 collection, created with Family 3.0 and filmed in chiaroscuro between record shelves and sound systems.
- [KAPPA · US ENDOUME jersey 26/27](https://angramm.com/work/endoume-kappa/) (2026): The US Endoume 26/27 jersey kit by Kappa: the neighbourhood club founded in 1925, worn through the streets, beaches and creeks of Marseille, from Notre-Dame-de-la-Garde to the Vallon des Auffes.
- [CROCS x SAiSON x C2MARS · CROCS2MARS](https://angramm.com/work/crocs-saison/) (2024): Crocs lands in Marseille with SAiSON and Chroniques2mars: a mock news flash, street football and Crocs by the sea for a limited-edition drop.
- [UMBRO x SAiSON x C2MARS · CLASSIC2MARS](https://angramm.com/work/umbro/) (2024): A neighbourhood pitch below Notre-Dame-de-la-Garde and the man who paints its lines: a film for Umbro, SAiSON and Chroniques2mars about grassroots football in Marseille.
- [ADIDAS x Family 3.0 · Adizero Evo SL](https://angramm.com/work/adidas-adizero/) (2025): From orbit to asphalt: the adidas Adizero Evo SL with Family 3.0, mixing CGI with a run at first light.
- [LACOSTE SS25 x Family 3.0 · Tennis to seaside](https://angramm.com/work/lacoste-ss25/) (2025): Binoculars, boats and calanques: Lacoste's SS25 collection, created with Family 3.0 and shot in Marseille.
- [MIZUNO x VRUNK · Kyan, São Paulo](https://angramm.com/work/mizuno-vrunk-sao-paulo/) (2026): The Mizuno × Vrunk collection in São Paulo with KYAN: sneakers, tracksuits and the city's alleys, cut to the rhythm of the street.
- [MIZUNO x VRUNK · Rio de Janeiro](https://angramm.com/work/mizuno-rio/) (2026): A Rio de Janeiro favela lights up: the Mizuno × Vrunk collection told through hustle, energy and light, from rooftop barbers to a logo glowing over the city.
- [MIZUNO x VRUNK · Ven1, Nanterre](https://angramm.com/work/mizuno-vrunk/) (2025): Motocross, drifting and CGI: the Mizuno × Vrunk collection staged with Ven1 among the towers of Nanterre, under a rain of petals.
- [PUMA · Olympique de Marseille third jersey 25/26](https://angramm.com/work/om-cma-cgm/): PUMA and Olympique de Marseille unveil the 2025/26 third jersey at the port of Marseille, shot among the containers and the dockers who keep the port running.
